name: run-flow-parent-variable-and-own-env
description: runFlow's own env override wins over a parent variable of the same name, while a parent variable with no override still interpolates into the loaded flow
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: run flow env merge
env:
  greeting: parent-hi
  email: user@test.com
---
- launchApp
- runFlow:
    file: "{{DIR}}/subflow.yml"
    env:
      greeting: step-hi
